result: Set within the grim, dystopian borders of the fictional city-state of Khansaar, this gripping tale centers on the powerful bond between two unlikely allies. Deva, a resilient tribesman, shares a deep and enduring friendship with Varadha, the royal prince of this troubled territory. Together, their connection forms the emotional heart of a dangerous world where power is everything.

The stability of the realm is shattered when a treacherous coup d'état is orchestrated against the throne by the prince's own relatives and his father's ministers. Facing betrayal from all sides, Varadha must turn to his loyal friend Deva for assistance. In a desperate bid to reclaim his birthright, the prince enlists the tribesman's help to overcome the conspirators and establish himself as the undisputed ruler of Khansaar.
